messages:
Maya (Support): Heads-up: ClearStream reported a throughput regression on their dedicated pool after enabling the new quantized route. p95 went from 210ms to ~980ms around 2026-03-19T22:05Z.
Liam (Sales): They pinged me this AM. They're concerned about repeatability and want a mitigation plan + timeline. Committed contract.
Maya (Support): Ticket has traces and a short flamegraph. Symptoms: elevated request queue length, repeated KV recompute, and occasional 503s when queue exceeded soft-limits.
Rhea (Product): Need immediate triage: what mitigations are least risky and what's the roadmap ask? Also how to position to customer re: credits/SLAs.
Omar (Eng Runtime): Quick read: quantized path increases memory pressure on KV caches for long sequences. Combined with their traffic pattern (many overlapping long sequences), it causes cache eviction churn and small effective batch sizes. Hypothesis: mismatch between cache sizing & eviction policy and customer seqlen distribution.
Tao (Eng Platform): Autoscaler behaved as designed but didn't trigger extra instances because QPS threshold for scale was not hit; we need a smarter scaling signal.
Nina (SRE): Observed node-level swap spikes and context switch bursts. We should throttle or isolate the route while we fix.
Maya (Support): Customer is asking for a rollback to the non-quantized model for their routes if we can't show progress in <2h.
Liam (Sales): If rollback is needed, we must evaluate impact on other customers using shared pools. Also log the ask for potential SLA credit.
Omar (Eng Runtime): Mitigation options: 1) route-specific rollback to fp16 model (fast) 2) enable per-route larger KV cache + tuned eviction (config change) 3) apply a per-route sequence-length gate to keep long sequences off quantized path until validated 4) temporarily pin more workers.
Rhea (Product): Tradeoffs? Rollback is lowest risk but negates perf gains. Cache bump might work but could increase memory pressure elsewhere. Sequence gate sounds like long-term safe approach.
Tao (Eng Platform): We can push a route-level cache sizing override quickly (propagates in ~45s) and also set a sequence-length threshold per route via feature flag. Both are per-route and reversible.
Nina (SRE): If we change cache sizing, watch memory headroom; I'll prepare node-level alerts and a rollback hook.
Rhea (Product): Decision: apply route-level cache-size bump + sequence-length gate for ClearStream as immediate mitigation. If p95 doesn't drop 50% in 30m, rollback to fp16. Create priority backlog item for runtime eviction policy fix and rollout gating automation.
Liam (Sales): I'll inform ClearStream: applying targeted config changes now, expect improvement in ~10m, will update in 30m. Asking for patience before a rollback.
Maya (Support): Applying cache override: /routes/clearstream/cache.size = 2GB and /routes/clearstream/seq_gate.max_tokens = 2048
deploy-bot: route-config patch by Tao: clearstream cache.size=2GB seq_gate=2048 (deploy dpl-8941).
Tao (Eng Platform): Patch live on 4/4 clusters.
Omar (Eng Runtime): Metrics: p95 down from 980ms -> 320ms after ~8 minutes; queue depth reduced and 503s stopped. Batch sizes improved slightly.
Liam (Sales): Customer confirmed partial recovery, monitoring for next hour. Will escalate SLA credit ask if we end up rolling back.
Rhea (Product): Backlog action: create PROD-6199 "Runtime: quantized KV eviction policy + seqlen-aware rollout guards". Acceptance criteria: 1) reproduce failing workload in staging with ClearStream-like seqlen distribution, 2) implement eviction policy that bounds churn (benchmarks show <10% extra recompute overhead), 3) add per-route seqlen gating and automated canary that enrolls 1% traffic then scales to 10% with health checks, 4) docs & runbook for ops.
Omar (Eng Runtime): I'll own PROD-6199 and propose a spec by EOD. Plan includes microbenchmarks, cache simulator, and a config schema for gating.
Nina (SRE): I'll add an alert rule: combine p95>500ms for 5m + cache_miss_rate>15% => pager to eng-runtime oncall. Also add a dashboard tile for route-level cache misses.
Maya (Support): Closing immediate customer incident as mitigation worked; keeping PROD-6199 as P0 bug. Documenting customer communication and next steps in ticket.
Rhea (Product): We'll slot this for next sprint planning. If ClearStream requests a financial remedy, escalate to leadership. Thanks all.
Liam (Sales): Noted. I'll coordinate with finance and legal if they ask for credits.
Maya (Support): Thread resolved for now. Leaving PROD-6199 open. :white_check_mark:
